SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_vote_pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, called_winner, called_party, status, rating
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code = 'GA'
ORDER BY CAST(district AS UNSIGNED);
